notes: SEC CIK 1327811 resolved from the name.

Latest 10-K (FY2026) gives 'over 21,000' as of 2026-01-31. No full annual report with an exact figure, fact sheet or press release found; the FY2026 ARS was not fully checked. Revelio (about 21,226, March 2026) agrees with the 10-K. The LinkedIn member count (25,217) runs about 20% above filed headcount, plausible for white-collar software; LinkedIn-derived trackers (AltIndex 25,212; growth about 6.7% March to September 2026) are not used as sources. The website '3,500 Employees' refers to customer size (under 3,500 employees), not Workday's headcount, and is excluded. The September 2026 layoff (~2.5%, about 500 roles by the notes' arithmetic) postdates the 10-K as-of date. Revelio's trend (-1.1%) conflicts with the 10-K history (+2.9%).
